answer: New identities start quarantined in a lagoon: for one full epoch they must answer unpredictable pulse challenges at random intervals, each demanding a fresh sequential computation that cannot be precomputed or shared across clones. Difficulty doubles for every additional identity whose timing fingerprint correlates with another, so ten clones cost far more than ten times one identity. Only survivors may cross the bridge into the main economy, and crossing burns their quarantine bond, so a burned bond can never fund a second clone.
